metadata.methods_description: EEG signals were recorded using a BioSemi ActiveTwo system with 64 electrodes positioned according to the international 10-20 system, plus bilateral earlobe reference electrodes. Electrooculography was recorded from four electrodes (vertical and horizontal placements around the right eye). Additional physiological measurements included wrist electrodes for heart rate variability and a respiration belt. Sampling rate was 2048 Hz.
